page.overview:
Who is Big Guy the Stilted?

Big Guy the Stilted is a giant robotic Shy Guy on Stilts operated by multiple Shy Guys in Yoshi's Island DS. He is the fourth main boss of the game, and is fought inside his castle, where he resides alongside many Shy Guys. To defeat him, Blue Yoshi must use eggs (or Baby Bowser's fire breath) to knock Big Guy the Stilted off the edge of the platform they are fighting on, which is surrounded by lava, giving Blue Yoshi a chance to ground-pound him. Many Shy Guys are inside this robot, jumping out occasionally, making for an easy egg supply. After three Ground Pounds, it cracks, exposing all of the Shy Guy operators, after which it falls into the lava.
